steps.en: Start the open-source container (point MB_DB_* at Postgres for production)
steps.zh: 启动开源版容器（生产环境用 MB_DB_* 指向 Postgres）

steps.en: Open the setup page, create the admin and add your database connection
steps.zh: 打开设置页，建管理员，填上你的数据库连接

steps.en: Syncs the schema and samples column values so it knows tables, keys and filter options
steps.zh: 同步表结构、抽样列值，摸清有哪些表、主外键和过滤选项

steps.en: Anyone picks a table, filters and summarizes by clicking — or writes SQL
steps.zh: 任何人点选表、过滤、汇总——或者直接写 SQL

steps.en: Turns the clicks into SQL for that database, runs it and picks a chart
steps.zh: 把点选翻译成该数据库的 SQL，执行并自动选图

steps.en: Serves saved questions on shared dashboards with filters for the whole team
steps.zh: 把保存的问题放上带筛选器的共享看板，全队都能看

value.en: People outside the data team answer their own questions without filing a SQL request
value.zh: 数据团队以外的人不用再提 SQL 需求单，自己就能查到答案

sources: https://github.com/metabase/metabase/blob/master/docs/installation-and-operation/running-metabase-on-docker.md (docker run, localhost:3000, MB_DB_* for Postgres app DB)
https://github.com/metabase/metabase#key-features (ask questions without SQL, SQL editor, dashboards with filters)
